brief.goal: 为 Codex 多模态实验台生成第一张可用于页面展示的概念主视觉。
asset_usage: 页面资产落点区预览图

structured_prompt.zh: 一个本地 AI 多模态创作实验台的概念主视觉。深色产品工作台中，从左到右展示截图输入、中文分析报告、结构化 Prompt 卡片和最终概念图资产。整体克制、专业、结构清晰，有创造力但不过度科幻。黑玻璃界面、细边框、柔白文字块、酸性黄绿色状态信号，画面像高质量产品概念图而不是实际 UI 截图。
structured_prompt.en: A concept hero image for a local AI multimodal creative lab. On a dark product workspace, show a left-to-right workflow from screenshot input to a Chinese analysis report, structured prompt cards, and a final concept art asset preview. Restrained, professional, clearly structured, inventive but not overly sci-fi. Black glass interface surfaces, fine borders, soft white report blocks, acid-lime status signals. It should feel like polished product concept art, not an actual UI screenshot.
structured_prompt.negative: no external API logos, no random brand marks, no readable fake UI text, no tiny gibberish text, no watermark, no messy clutter, no robots, no neon overload

shot_list.purpose: 表现图片/截图分析输入
shot_list.framing: left side panel with screenshot thumbnails and local folder hints
shot_list.visual_notes: avoid readable fake filenames; use abstract document and image tiles

shot_list.purpose: 表现中文分析报告和 Prompt 结构化
shot_list.framing: center panel with report blocks and prompt cards
shot_list.visual_notes: use clean blocks and lines instead of legible text

shot_list.purpose: 表现 imagegen 概念图输出和项目资产落点
shot_list.framing: right side polished concept image preview with stable asset board
shot_list.visual_notes: make the final generated image preview the brightest focal point

acceptance_checks: 能看出输入、分析、输出三段闭环
没有外部服务标识或随机品牌
没有乱码文字成为视觉主体
适合放入 public/assets/codex-lab 并在页面预览

imagegen_prompts.prompt:
Use case: productivity-visual
Asset type: web page hero concept image
Primary request: A concept hero image for a local AI multimodal creative lab. On a dark product workspace, show a left-to-right workflow from screenshot input to a Chinese analysis report, structured prompt cards, and a final concept art asset preview.
Scene/backdrop: restrained dark product workspace with local project folders, abstract screenshot thumbnails, clean analysis report blocks, prompt cards, and an accepted concept image board.
Subject: a verifiable three-step workflow from image or screenshot analysis to structured prompt pack to imagegen concept asset.
Style/medium: polished editorial 3D illustration with realistic product surfaces, not an actual UI screenshot.
Composition/framing: 16:9 landscape, left-to-right process path, clear focal point on the final concept image preview, usable negative space.
Lighting/mood: precise soft studio lighting, calm, capable, inventive.
Color palette: charcoal black, warm white, acid lime accents, restrained cyan details.
Constraints: no external API logos, no random brand marks, no readable fake UI text, no tiny gibberish text, no watermark, no messy clutter, no robots, no neon overload.
